Class StandardScriptEvaluator

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scripting.support.StandardScriptEvaluator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, ScriptEvaluator
public class StandardScriptEvaluator extends Object implements ScriptEvaluator, BeanClassLoaderAware
`javax.script`(JSR-223) 实现的 Spring `ScriptEvaluator`策略接口。
Since:
4.0
Author:
Juergen Hoeller，Costin Leau
See Also:

  • Method Details

    • setLanguage

      public void setLanguage(String language)
      Set the name of the language meant for evaluating the scripts (for example, "Groovy").

      这实际上是 `"engineName"` 的别名，可能会（但目前尚未）提供某些语言的常用缩写，这些缩写超出了 JSR-223 脚本引擎工厂所暴露的范围。

      See Also:
      • setEngineName(String)

    • setEngineName

      Since:

      public void setBeanClassLoader(ClassLoader classLoader)
      描述从接口复制：BeanClassLoaderAware
      Callback that supplies the bean class loader to a bean instance.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后但初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法或自定义 init-method）之前之前调用。

      Specified by:
